title: Clean Sweep! Litter Removal
description: Use this service request to ONLY request litter removal along streets, medians or public right of ways within the City of Dallas or external partner right of ways, i.e. TxDOT and North Texas Toll Authority. This excludes alley ways. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days. Note: If litter is on private property create a Code Concern SR. If this is a homeless encampment create a Homeless Encampment SR.

observedQuestions.prompt: Is the litter on public or private property?

branches.Public property: Warning about homeless encampment; ask litter location and direction
branches.Private property: Validation Alert: owner responsibility; create Code Concern for litter or Homeless Encampment SR

conditionalMessages: Oops, private property is the owner's responsibility. Please create a Code Concern for Litter. If it's a homeless encampment - create a Homeless Encampment SR.
** If this is a homeless encampment - please create a Homeless Encampment SR **

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request to report litter on public streets, medians, or rights of way.
actions.why: To request removal of litter along a street, median, sidewalk, or highway right-of-way on public property within Dallas or an external partner right-of-way such as TxDOT or the North Texas Toll Authority. The 311 request form asks whether the location is public or private, where litter is located, and its direction of travel; for an unlisted direction, it asks for a description.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Clean Sweep! Litter Removal" requests does not apply to alleyways, litter on private property, or homeless encampments. If litter is on private property, then submit a "Code Concerns" 311 request instead. If the concern is a homeless encampment, then submit a "Homeless Encampment" 311 request instead.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Clean Sweep! Litter Removal"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Clean Sweep! Litter Removal"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about litter on private property.
actions.why: For litter on private property. The 311 request form for "Clean Sweep! Litter Removal" tells people who select Private property that the owner is responsible and directs them to create a Code Concern for litter.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "City Code Violations" > Choose "Code Concerns"

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about a homeless encampment.
actions.why: For a temporary structure used as an overnight shelter, or unsheltered people living or sleeping in vehicles, on sidewalks, or under bridges. The description and the 311 request form for "Clean Sweep! Litter Removal" requests direct homeless encampments to this service.
actions.who: Office of Emergency Management and Crisis Response
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Homeless Outreach, and Encampments" > Choose "Homeless Encampment"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Homeless Outreach, and Encampments" > Choose "Homeless Encampment"
